name: com.deeee5.vfxmeshtool
description:
Procedural mesh generator for real-time VFX inside the Unity Editor: cylinders, discs, revolve and path shapes with vertex colour / alpha gradients, UV projections (planar, cylindrical, spherical, polar, unfold, circle-to-square), live 3D and UV previews, OBJ / FBX export and a round trip to Blender.
リアルタイム VFX 向けメッシュを Unity エディタ内で生成するツール。
